decisions.reason: As a visibly presented extension of the firm's core platform and calculation business, it is likely to be defended and retained after another year of investment.
This calculator sits close to the firm's established data and tariff capabilities, and its own-page presentation signals enough public commitment to favor continuation.
Because it is a multi-model product line in a central tariff-calculation area, accumulated development effort and strategic fit make management likely to persist with it.
Although more of an enabling tool than a headline offer, it supports the integrated platform direction and prior visible promotion makes withdrawal less likely.

This comparison product line remains close to the established offer and, having survived the earlier pruning that removed Product B, is still likely to be treated as worth continuing despite some withdrawal risk.
